name: Jessie — Open Consent Request — v13 (all day deadlines)

parameters.content:
## Open Consent Request (v12, slice 2)
Writes a PENDING row to the Consent Requests tab (real Slack ids; the booking's engineer as Approver 2 for a priority request; the same request asked again returns the open one), then Jessie — Request Messages posts the requester's card and the request with buttons, and where they went is kept on the row (Messages). An audit line still goes to #jessie-approvals. Called by Book Session (and Move Booking) at the ROOM_OCCUPIED + request point.

// the row exactly as the sheet's columns
return [{ json: $('Build Request').first().json.row }];
